keys.key: A file with this name exists already in this folder.
keys.text: A file with this name exists already in this folder.
keys.hint: Drive screen (cloud drive of the admin): error after an upload: a file with the same name is already in the target folder.
Agent chat, file card of the drive: state line of a file whose malware check is still running (not yet downloadable).
Agent chat, file card of the drive: state line of a file the malware check blocked (cannot be opened or downloaded).
Drive screen: placeholder of the space picker button when no space is chosen (a space = one storage area of the drive).
Drive screen, tooltip of the storage pill: part of the used storage taken by the current version of each file.
File manager details drawer, history: event type: someone downloaded the file.
Drive screen (cloud drive of the admin): page title of the file storage screen.

keys.key: No free name was found for the copy. Rename a copy in this folder and retry.
keys.text: No free name was found for the copy. Rename a copy in this folder and retry.
keys.hint: Drive, error message when an edited text should be saved as a copy beside the original but the names "… (copy)", "… (copy 2)" … up to 6 are all taken in the folder.
Drive screen, space picker: shown when the search finds no space.
Drive screen, tooltip of the storage pill: part of the used storage taken by older, kept versions of files.

keys.key: Open the file again and retry.
keys.text: Open the file again and retry.
keys.hint: Drive screen: error when a new version of a file cannot be uploaded because the file's details are not loaded; the user should reopen the file.
File manager details drawer, history: event type: the AI agent read the file.
Drive screen, space picker: placeholder of the search field.
File canvas beside the agent chat (one drive file opened from a file list of the agent): link to the file's place in the drive screen.

keys.key: The drive answered without the file.
keys.text: The drive answered without the file.
keys.hint: Drive screen: error when the server confirmed an upload but returned no file.

keys.key: The location could not be opened.
keys.text: The location could not be opened.
keys.hint: Error under the path field when looking up the typed path failed for another reason than 'not found' (for example a network error).

keys.key: The spaces could not be loaded.
keys.text: The spaces could not be loaded.
keys.hint: Drive screen: error message when the list of storage spaces failed to load.

keys.key: There is no space you may read.
keys.text: There is no space you may read.
keys.hint: Drive screen: empty state: the signed-in user may read no storage space.

keys.key: This drive needs mgamadeus/ddd-clouddrive 0.1.0-rc.10 or newer on the server.
keys.text: This drive needs mgamadeus/ddd-clouddrive 0.1.0-rc.10 or newer on the server.
keys.hint: Drive screen: shown to developers when the server's drive module is too old for this screen; keep the package name and version as they are.

keys.key: This file is not available. It was removed, or you may not open it.
keys.text: This file is not available. It was removed, or you may not open it.
keys.hint: File canvas beside the agent chat: the drive file no longer exists, is a folder, or the reader has no right to it.

keys.key: This folder is not available. It was removed, or you may not open it.
keys.text: This folder is not available. It was removed, or you may not open it.
keys.hint: Drive folder opened beside the agent chat: shown instead of the file list when the folder was deleted or the user has no right to read it.
Drive screen, tooltip of the storage pill: part of the used storage taken by files in the trash.
Drive screen, tooltip of the storage pill: part of the used storage taken by uploads still in the malware check.
File manager details drawer, history: event type: someone opened the file's preview.
Agent chat, file card of the drive: state line of a file whose content came from outside (e.g. a mail attachment or a web page), not from the owner.

keys.key: You may read this space, but not change it.
keys.text: You may read this space, but not change it.
keys.hint: Notice above the drive's file list when the user may open and download files of this space but not upload, rename, move or delete.
File manager (the admin's file area: folder tree, file list as grid or table, uploads, trash). ICU plural; # is the number.
